questions.q: Which institution regulates commercial banks in Pakistan?
questions.explanation: The State Bank of Pakistan is the central bank and regulator of the banking sector.

questions.q: What is the national animal of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: The Markhor, a wild goat, is the national animal of Pakistan.

questions.q: The head of the State Bank of Pakistan is officially titled the ___
questions.explanation: The central bank is headed by a Governor.

questions.q: Which city is the main financial and commercial hub of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Karachi hosts the stock exchange, the central bank and most corporate head offices.

questions.q: What is the national flower of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Jasmine (locally called chambeli) is the national flower of Pakistan.
The IMF (International Monetary Fund) is a global institution promoting financial stability.

questions.q: Which sport is traditionally regarded as the national game of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Field hockey is traditionally regarded as Pakistan's national game.

questions.q: Pakistan gained independence in which year?
questions.explanation: Pakistan came into being on 14 August 1947.
The WTO (World Trade Organization) deals with global trade rules.

questions.q: Which of these is a long-standing function of a central bank?
questions.explanation: Issuing a country's currency is a core, long-standing function of every central bank.
